name: Lag between a term's use and its descriptor (concept exists before its label)

origin.campaign: September 2026 — PubMed substrate and other corpora (Voûte)

seen.corpus: Author keywords of the baseline frozen 2026-08-18 (English, articles and reviews, 2011-2025) against MeSH history 2026, on the baseline frozen 2026-08-18
seen.document: federated learning (dated 2020-09, descriptor 2025-01); graph neural networks (2020-12 → 2025-01); spatial transcriptomics (2018-12 → 2026-01); tirzepatide (2020-12 → 2025-01); long covid (2022-01 → 2023-01) — public proof dossier v8 §8
seen.observer: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the Substrat measurement files
seen.excerpt: Dossier v8 : « un à sept ans » entre la datation et le descripteur ; « 3,7 ans avant MeSH en médiane » ; « signalement environ un an avant le descripteur officiel ».
seen.excerpt_en: Dossier v8: "one to seven years" between the dating and the descriptor; "3.7 years before MeSH in median"; "signalling about a year before the official descriptor".

prevention.note: not assessed by the observer; to be classified by the second reader

repair.note: deletion cannot restore this; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

obstacle.reason: Restoring a gap means ADDING, and a deletion-only repair has no such gesture. Its solution is a set of elements to delete; there is no insertion anywhere in it. No weight and no information change that answer.
obstacle.reason_fr: Réparer un manque veut dire AJOUTER, et une réparation par suppression n'a pas ce geste. Sa solution est un ensemble d'éléments à retirer ; il n'y a d'insertion nulle part. Aucun poids et aucune information n'y changent quoi que ce soit.
obstacle.source: derived from what a deletion-only repair can express, read in the repairer's own code — its solution is a set of elements to delete and carries no insertion — together with the measurement of 2026-09-10. Per damage class, not per form.

history.event: proposed by the Voûte Claude in 'FORMES-PUBMED-pour-Fault-Atlas (09-09-2026)' (part 1; final file sha256 51a338add43cd071…), form 19 of 23; effect on a graph: For years, thousands of articles carry an object the authority vocabulary does not know; at its creation the descriptor is retro-applied (see retro-indexing form). Prevalence: measured on five revealed positions; median 3.7 years over all positions.
history.by: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the Substrat measurement files

history.event: converted to a record; class, prevention and the novel/variant question left to the second reader
second reader: contested — the 3.7 figure is absent from v8

proposed_severity.reason: one to seven years between a term's use and its descriptor: searching by descriptor misses years of literature
proposed_severity.status: proposed — a second reader confirms or contests, as for the 43 validated forms
proposed_severity.note: this reading agrees with how the August catalogue judges most MISSING forms (G3), so it adds little
proposed_severity.reason_fr: un à sept ans entre l'usage d'un terme et son descripteur : chercher par descripteur manque des années de littérature

registry_scope.extent: every term between its use and its descriptor: one to seven years, 3.7 years median
registry_scope.why_not_a_prevalence: a fault of a registry has no prevalence: it is a property of the base, so everything drawn from that base carries it. What can be stated is the slice it touches.
registry_scope.source: read from this form's own observation, 2026-09-11
registry_scope.extent_fr: tout terme entre son usage et son descripteur : un à sept ans, 3,7 ans en médiane
